Proto-Indo-European *ís?

Middle Persian 𐭸 (1 /⁠ē(w)⁠/)
Persian ـی (-ē / -i)
Persian چای (čây)bor.
Arabic شاي
Borrowed from Persian چای (čây, “tea”), possibly borrowed from Chinese 茶葉 /茶叶 (“tea leaves”), or from چا (čā / čâ) + ـی (-ē / -i).
Ultimately from Chinese 茶 (chá, “tea”).
